case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment header: Ex-Gunner Virender Prasad v. Union of India & Anr.

number_of_accused.reason: Only one appellant is before the Court, consistent with the judgment.

accused_gender.reason: The judgment refers to the appellant as 'he' and 'his' throughout.

accused_age.reason: The judgment never states the accused's age. The value 25 has no support in the text.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states the appellant was enrolled in the Signals Corps and is titled Ex-Gunner.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not discussed in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned in the judgment.

victim_gender.reason: The victim is named 'Gunner-Sushil Kumar', a male name; the text does not contradict male gender.

victim_age.reason: The judgment does not state the deceased's age. The value 25 is unsupported.

victim_caste.reason: Caste of the victim is not mentioned.

victim_religion.reason: Religion of the victim is not mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Both were in the same unit and the appellant was 'on good terms' with the deceased.

offence_category.reason: The offence is a civil offence of murder, tried under Section 69 of the Army Act.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: Army Act s.69; Ranbir Penal Code s.302 (via Army Act s.69); Army Act ss.164(2) and 165; Code of Criminal Procedure s.433-A
statutory_provisions.quote: contrary to Section 302 of the Ranbir Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Lists Army Act s.69 and CrPC s.433-A but omits RPC s.302 and Army Act ss.164(2), 165.

weapon.reason: The judgment says the appellant fired a complete magazine of rifle ammunition.

evidence_type.correct_value: Testimony of 15 witnesses including a Psychiatrist; appellant's confession of guilt
evidence_type.quote: in all 15 witnesses including a Psychiatrist was examined
evidence_type.reason: Confession and psychiatrist testimony are supported, but 'circumstantial' evidence is not mentioned anywhere in the judgment.

confession.correct_value: Appellant surrendered and confessed his guilt to his Senior Authorities
confession.quote: surrendered himself to his Senior Authorities and confessed his guilt
confession.reason: A confession is supported, but the judgment does not say the court relied on it as evidence.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not identify aggravating circumstances, so 'Not noted' is accurate.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Surrender, excellent jail conduct and more than 14 years served are all stated in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Summary Court Martial found the appellant guilty of murder and sentenced him to life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Writ petition filed in Delhi High Court, later transferred to the AFT; no High Court decision reported
high_court_outcome.quote: preferred a writ petition in Delhi High Court, which was subsequently transferred to the AFT
high_court_outcome.reason: A Delhi High Court writ was filed, so 'Not applicable' is wrong, though no HC decision is reported.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction affirmed; sentence reduced to period already undergone and appellant ordered released
final_outcome.quote: while dismissing the appeal we direct that the appellant be forthwith released from custody
final_outcome.reason: The appeal was dismissed and conviction affirmed; the appellant was not acquitted.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Murder as a civil offence under Section 69 of the Army Act, 1950
offence_finally_established.quote: liable to be convicted for the offence punishable under Section 69 of the Army Act for committing a civil offence of murder
offence_finally_established.reason: The murder conviction under Section 69 was affirmed, so 'None' contradicts the judgment.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Life imprisonment (sentence reduced to period already undergone)
imprisonment_type.quote: sentence of life imprisonment reduced to the period already undergone
imprisonment_type.reason: The sentence imposed was life imprisonment, not 'none'.

imprisonment_years.reason: Sentence is life imprisonment, which has no fixed years; the judgment gives only time served, so null is defensible.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts summarised without reference to the sentence reduction or time served
neutral_facts.quote: he has served the sentence for a period of more than 14 years
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but stating the 14-year service and jail conduct reveals the court's reasoning and outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Life imprisonment is stated; the judgment does not specify minimum or maximum terms.

attempt_completion.reason: The deceased was shot and died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: The firing caused the death of the deceased.

number_of_offences.reason: The appellant was charged under Section 69 of the Army Act for murder, and the conviction was upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed, so 'Not applicable' is a reasonable reading.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment does not discuss premeditation; it describes a shooting in sleep under claimed delusion.

motive.reason: No motive is identified in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court accepted CM and AFT findings that the appellant was liable to be convicted under Section 69.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Judgment notes 15 witnesses, including a Psychiatrist, were examined; no credibility assessment is recorded
witness_credibility.quote: in all 15 witnesses including a Psychiatrist was examined
witness_credibility.reason: The judgment does not assess witness credibility; it only notes witnesses were examined and findings were not disturbed.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Immediate surrender, the explanation given, and excellent jail conduct are all stated.

custody_duration.reason: The judgment states the appellant had actually served 16 years and 6 months as on 6.1.2020.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date 30.06.2003, Court Martial 21.08.2004 and SC judgment 18.03.2020 match the text; HC decision not stated.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match those listed in the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: Challan before CJM Rajouri, transfer to Army for trial, and confirmation by CM and AFT are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment notes no procedural irregularity.

appeal_history.correct_value: Court Martial convicted; petition to MoD/COAS dismissed 22.05.2007; writ in Delhi HC transferred to AFT, which dismissed; SC dismissed appeal and reduced sentence
appeal_history.quote: Thereafter, the appellant preferred a writ petition in Delhi High Court
appeal_history.reason: Court Martial did not 'affirm' a conviction on appeal, and no High Court appeal was decided; the AFT did.

prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment records no prosecution arguments; the value restates the court's holding rather than a submission.

defence_argument.reason: Judgment records the appellant's contention of a delusion of militant attack and no control over his senses.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Santa Singh's amalgam-of-factors principle is quoted and applied, including prior record, age and mental condition.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: The three cases and their citations match those in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment states the sentence served is much more than proportionate and exceeds 14 years.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Kashmir terrorism context, immediate surrender and excellent jail behaviour are all stated.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are identified by the court, so 'None' is accurate.

other_sentence_order.reason: The Court directed the appellant be forthwith released from custody.
